choices.label: Celebrate with family
choices.resultText: You shared food, stories, and laughter together.

choices.label: Keep it low-key at home
choices.resultText: A quiet but meaningful observance.

choices.label: Skip the festivities
choices.resultText: You saved your energy and cash for another day.

choices.label: Join the community events
choices.resultText: Music, colour, and friendly faces everywhere.

choices.label: Watch from the sidelines
choices.resultText: You enjoyed the atmosphere without spending much.

events.text: Your family gathers for a holiday feast.

choices.label: Host generously
choices.resultText: Everyone left full and grateful.

choices.label: Keep it simple
choices.resultText: Warm conversation mattered more.

events.text: Street vendors set up early for {holidayName}. The smell of grilled food and sugar pulls you toward the stalls.

choices.label: Buy treats and share them
choices.resultText: Sticky fingers, loud music, and a full belly. {holidayName} feels like it belongs to you.

choices.label: Help a stall pack up at dusk
choices.resultText: The vendor slips you leftovers. Kindness travels farther than fireworks.

choices.label: Go home before the crowds peak
choices.resultText: You miss the noise. You also miss the headache.

events.text: A neighbour asks if you will help hang decorations for {holidayName}. The ladder looks older than the tradition.

choices.label: Climb up and hang the lights
choices.resultText: The street glows by nightfall. People stop to take photos.

choices.label: Hold the ladder and pass tape
choices.resultText: You stay useful without the risk. The neighbour still invites you to tea.

choices.label: Make an excuse and walk on
choices.resultText: The block still celebrates. You just are not in the picture.

events.text: {holidayDescription} A family group chat explodes with travel plans, recipes, and old arguments.

choices.label: Offer to host and cook
choices.resultText: The house is loud and messy. People linger after dessert.

choices.label: Show up with a dish and leave early
choices.resultText: You did your part. Peace and a full plate.

choices.label: Mute the chat until it is over
choices.resultText: Quiet. Also a few cold messages the next morning.

events.text: Children on your street practice a {holidayName} performance. They are missing a drummer — or at least someone who can keep time.

choices.label: Join the rehearsal
choices.resultText: You clap off-beat and they still cheer. The performance is chaotic and perfect.

choices.label: Film it and share with family
choices.resultText: Relatives reply with heart emojis. You become the unofficial historian.

choices.label: Watch from a doorway
choices.resultText: A small smile is enough. The song follows you home.

events.text: Tickets for a {holidayName} concert sell out in minutes. A friend knows someone selling extras at a markup.

choices.label: Pay the markup and go
choices.resultText: The night is huge. Your budget is not. Worth it, mostly.

choices.label: Stream it at home with snacks
choices.resultText: Not the same as being there. Also no queues, and the fridge is close.

choices.label: Skip it and save the money
choices.resultText: You hear the bass from two streets over. Your savings stay intact.

events.text: An elder asks you to visit a grave or memorial during {holidayName}. The request is quiet and serious.

choices.label: Go and listen to the stories
choices.resultText: Names become people. You leave slower than you arrived.

choices.label: Send flowers and a message
choices.resultText: Respect from a distance. They notice you tried.

choices.label: Promise to go next year
choices.resultText: Next year is a long time. The elder does not argue.

events.text: A sudden downpour hits the {holidayName} parade. Costumes bleed colour onto the asphalt.

choices.label: Dance in the rain anyway
choices.resultText: You are soaked and laughing. Photos of you go around the family group.

choices.label: Share your umbrella with strangers
choices.resultText: Three people squeeze under one canopy. Someone buys you a drink after.

choices.label: Duck into a café until it passes
choices.resultText: Warm, dry, slightly guilty. The parade moves on without you.

events.text: Work still expects you on {holidayName}. A manager hints that covering the shift is 'noticed'.

choices.label: Work the shift for the extra pay
choices.resultText: The office is empty and echoey. Your account looks healthier.

choices.label: Swap with a coworker who needs the money
choices.resultText: They owe you one. You spend {holidayName} where you actually wanted to be.

choices.label: Call in and take the day
choices.resultText: Family notices you. Your manager notices too.

events.text: Someone suggests a new {holidayName} tradition this year — a walk at dawn instead of the usual feast.

choices.label: Wake up and walk with them
choices.resultText: The streets are empty. Conversation is easier when nobody is performing.

choices.label: Sleep in and join the meal later
choices.resultText: You catch the best part: food and leftover stories.

choices.label: Insist on doing it the old way
choices.resultText: The feast happens. The mood is a little tighter than last year.

events.text: A charity drive for {holidayName} needs volunteers to pack boxes. The warehouse is cold and the list is long.

choices.label: Stay until the last box is sealed
choices.resultText: Your back aches. The organiser remembers your name.

choices.label: Give a donation and leave
choices.resultText: Money helps. Time would have helped more, and you know it.

choices.label: Drop in for an hour of photos
choices.resultText: You look generous online. The people still packing boxes do not comment.

events.text: Every terminal is brimming with travelers boarding the {transportMode} to reunite with extended family for {holidayName}.

choices.label: Assist an elderly traveler with heavy luggage onto the {transportMode}
choices.resultText: They shower you with traditional holiday blessings. Traveling with good deeds makes the journey fly by.

choices.label: Enjoy festive songs echoing through the transit cabin with fellow passengers
choices.resultText: Strangers share roasted snacks and sing along to holiday radio hits as landscapes roll by.

choices.label: Secure a window seat and reflect quietly on the passing year
choices.resultText: Watching rolling hills and holiday decorations outside soothes your mind and clarifies your goals.

events.text: Neighbors call out "{greeting}!" from open verandas as cooking aromas fill the lane in honor of {holidayName}. {holidayDescription}

choices.label: Bring a homemade specialty dish to the communal street table
choices.resultText: Neighbors lick their fingers and demand the recipe! Community camaraderie warms the entire block.

choices.label: Help string colorful festival lights across the courtyard trees
choices.resultText: As twilight falls, the lanterns twinkle brightly, drawing gasps of wonder from neighborhood children.

choices.label: Sit with the elders to listen to traditional folklore tales
choices.resultText: Their voices recount ancient triumphs and historical resilience, grounding you in your heritage.

events.text: Following traditional {holidayName} prayers, family members send digital festival gift tokens and blessings to younger relatives via {moneyApp}.

choices.label: Send generous gift tokens to younger cousins and nieces via {moneyApp}
choices.resultText: Excited notifications chime across young relatives' phones. Their giggles and thankful voice notes brighten your day.

choices.label: Match contributions with words of personal mentorship and encouragement
choices.resultText: Younger family members appreciate both the modest festival cash and your thoughtful guidance.

choices.label: Save your budget while offering warm in-person blessings and hugs
choices.resultText: Presence matters more than cash. You spend quality hours baking treats and chatting with relatives.

events.text: Town squares come alive under starry skies for {holidayName}. Marching bands, illuminated floats, and joyful singing fill the streets.

choices.label: Carry a ceremonial lantern in the community procession
choices.resultText: You marched amidst drums and cheers, holding your glowing lantern high alongside community leaders.

choices.label: Volunteer as a route safety steward helping families find parking
choices.resultText: Your helpful directions kept crowds moving smoothly and ensured lost children were promptly reunited.

choices.label: Cheer enthusiastically from the sidewalk with family and friends
choices.resultText: You clapped as dancers in traditional regalia spun by, soaking in the civic holiday energy.

events.text: In the spirit of {holidayName}, community volunteers pack wholesome food hampers for neighborhood elders and low-income families.

choices.label: Spend your morning packing and distributing care parcels
choices.resultText: Elders wiped away tears as you delivered fresh provisions. Service to others is the true essence of {holidayName}.

choices.label: Donate generously to fund the supplies via {moneyApp}
choices.resultText: Your donation purchased sacks of rice, flour, and cooking oil for twenty vulnerable households.

choices.label: Coordinate delivery logistics and drivers across town
choices.resultText: Your spreadsheet and route maps ensured every single hamper reached its intended doorstep without delay.

events.text: As the clocks strike midnight to welcome {holidayName}, elders gather the household to offer thanks, remember ancestors, and share hopes for the coming year.

choices.label: Lead the family in words of gratitude and reflection
choices.resultText: Your heartfelt speech brings tears of pride to elders' eyes. Family bonds deepen under candlelight.

choices.label: Listen attentively to ancestral tales by candlelight
choices.resultText: You committed family history to memory, honoring the struggles that paved the way for your generation.

choices.label: Prepare warm spiced tea and snacks for everyone present
choices.resultText: Steaming cups of tea warm hands and hearts as quiet conversation extends into the early hours.
